raw_support_spans.text: A man in his 50s presented with new and progressive satellite lesions while undergoing pembrolizumab therapy.
Multiple satellite lesions were present on the left posterior auricular scalp area.

generator_assessments.assessment: Histopathology: Initial findings: Incidentally resected lymph node showed focal involvement
Immunostaining results: * SOX-10 and MART-1: Highlighted normal melanocytes in basal layer of epidermis only
The patient's history of a scalp lesion, lymph node involvement, and the presence of melanocytes on immunostaining support the diagnosis of melanoma.
